parts.text: Master’s research internship combining constraint-based generation of valid test cases with machine-learning predictions to prioritize cases likely to expose defects or meet testing objectives. Work should deliver a TAF prototype, experimental dataset and assessment of benefits and limitations for dependable autonomous systems. Hosted at LAAS-CNRS in Toulouse, supervised by Hélène Waeselynck and Jérémie Guiochet. Requires Python and basic machine learning; constraint solving or simulator experience is an advantage. Apply with CV, cover letter and two years of transcripts through the source page. No closing date is stated.
